fonts.description: Clean grotesque sans substituting Space Grotesk due to dashboard constraints

visual_enhancers.textures: CSS-based subtle noise overlay on the background to eliminate digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border (e.g. #262626) on all cards, panels, and side-rails.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Avoid soft shadows. Use sharp 1px inner glows or stark borders.
visual_enhancers.glows: Subtle inset drop shadow or text-shadow for neon green elements (only on verified/evidence states).

grids.topology_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. 3 strict columns representing LOCAL, SECURE LINK, REMOTE. Do not merge.
grids.evidence_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Bento-style grid for ~10 recorded evidence cards.
grids.roadmap_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. 3 columns: Working, Next, Future.

layouts.overall: Sticky side-rail navigation layout. Left aside (e.g., w-64) with main content area on the right.
layouts.header: Top identity/hero header spanning main content. Strong proposition, release provenance, mode toggle.
layouts.spacing: Generous. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-8 between major sections. mb-12 for section separation.

motion.hover: Subtle background lighten (bg-white/5), 1px border color shift.
motion.entrance: Soft entrance fades. opacity 0 -> 1 over 0.3s. No bouncy translations.
motion.drawer: Smooth slide-in from the right for evidence details.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG adherence. Text on unavailable states must remain readable.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='mode-toggle').

3d_libraries.usage: None. Strict 2D technical layout to preserve credibility and sober tactical feel.

background.description: No external images. Use pure CSS noise/grain if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up a sticky compact side-rail navigation on the left (Overview, Architecture, State Ladder, Evidence, Roadmap).
Build the Top Identity Header: Needs PhoneBoost proposition ('Use the power already in your pocket'), release tag, HEAD, validation date.
Implement the Global Mode Toggle (LIVE vs RECORDED EVIDENCE). When LIVE is selected, show a clear 'unavailable' curtain state over the dashboard, as no real data is fabricated.
Build the Topology panel (LOCAL <-> SECURE LINK <-> REMOTE): Use a 3-column grid. Ensure visually distinct boundaries. Use '--unavailable' styling for hosted components.
Build the Five-gate state ladder: Stacked list/cards. Use neutral/unavailable styling. Do not show progress bars to avoid implying sequential success.
Build the Security Callout: Plain language summary + technical details. Use JetBrains Mono for peer IDs and technical terms.
Build the Evidence Grid: ~10 cards. Use muted green accents to denote RECORDED EVIDENCE. Clicking a card opens a Sheet (side drawer) with source path and raw checked-in text.
Build the Roadmap: 3 columns (Working/Demonstrated now, Next, Future).
Ensure the entire app feels like a premium, sober, tactical competition dashboard. No flashy gradients.
Apply `data-testid` to every interactive element (buttons, tabs, toggles, cards that open drawers).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use Space Grotesk (forbidden for dashboards). Use Chivo or Cabinet Grotesk for headings instead.
Use JetBrains Mono for all technical data, logs, and evidence text.
Strictly separate LOCAL, SECURE LINK, and REMOTE resources.
Never fabricate data. If it's not live, style it as unavailable/neutral.
Use 1px sharp borders instead of soft shadows to maintain the tactical lab feel.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid charcoal/graphite.
Left-align dense content and text. Do not center-align the app.
Apply data-testid to all interactive components.
No emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) than standard to give a premium feel.
